test_title: PYST 16 - SSC CHSL 2025 - English Language (Held On: 18 Nov, 2025 Shift 2)
subject: english
question:
**Choose the correct passive voice transformation of the sentence:**

The famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste, is organizing a special exhibition.

options.text: A special exhibition is organized by the famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste.
A special exhibition is being organized by the famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste.
A special exhibition was being organized by the famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste.
A special exhibition has been organized by the famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste.

solution:
The correct answer is '2' i.e. A special exhibition is being organized by the famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste .

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The given sentence is in the **present continuous tense**, as indicated by the use of the verb **"is organizing."**
 
• When converting a sentence from active voice to passive voice, the **tense** of the verb must remain the same. For present continuous, the structure becomes **"is/are being + past participle."**
 
• In this case, the subject "The famous art curator" becomes the agent, and the object "A special exhibition" becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.

Correct sentence: *A special exhibition is being organized by the famous art curator, who is known for his unique taste*.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Passive Voice Transformation Rules:**

 
 
• **Identify the verb tense:** Ensure the tense remains the same while transforming into passive voice.
 
• **Rearrange the sentence:** The object of the active voice sentence becomes the subject of the passive voice sentence.
 
• **Use appropriate auxiliary verbs:** Add "is/are being" for present continuous tense.
 
• **Add the past participle of the main verb:** Use the third form of the verb.
 
 
 
• **Example of Passive Voice Transformation:**
 
 
• **Active Voice:** The chef is preparing a delicious meal.
 
• **Passive Voice:** A delicious meal is being prepared by the chef.
